tasks.label: SimCore: Flash
tasks.detail: Picks from the serial ports actually present
args: DIRECTORY=${input:buildDirectory} && source "${workspaceFolder}/tools/idf-env.sh" $DIRECTORY >/dev/null && { [ -f $DIRECTORY/project_description.json ] || { echo "Run the SimCore build task for $DIRECTORY first."; exit 1; }; } && PORT=$(python3 "${workspaceFolder}/tools/pick-serial-port.py" --for flash) && if [ "$PORT" = auto ]; then ESPBAUD=460800 idf.py -B $DIRECTORY flash; else ESPBAUD=460800 idf.py -B $DIRECTORY -p "$PORT" flash; fi
